interpretation_law.path_presence: A directory or file proves only observed local presence. It does not prove release identity, completeness, source-profile conformance, world admission, seed completion, model behavior, or product activation.
interpretation_law.source_profile: A conforming source profile must bind authority, release, license, artifact graph, syntax provider, recipe, AST mapping, references, testimony, denominators, conformance, completion, and readback.
interpretation_law.seed: A foundational seed is a configured heterogeneous selected boundary whose profiles, cross-profile references, dependence, evidence epochs, and required derived publications all close in the activated product.
interpretation_law.observation: Corpora, examples, games, annotations, measurements, and model behavior remain attributable observations or testimony; they are not automatically foundational authority.
interpretation_law.model: Model files are witnessed artifacts. File shape and local loadability do not prove behavior, effective support, a preserved export invariant, or semantic authority.
interpretation_law.model_precision_precedence: When a complete full-precision safetensors package exists, it is the primary model-artifact witness. AWQ, GGUF, TorchScript, PyTorch duplicates, and other quantized, compiled, converted, or runtime-specific forms are subordinate derived artifacts and require an explicit source binding, conversion recipe, named preservation invariant, loss boundary, and behavioral receipt. They are never substitutes for the full-precision source package.
interpretation_law.edge: UAX 29 is Unicode text-edge segmentation law. A source grammar, archive codec, media codec, or model-container reader exposes concrete structure; none may become a semantic engine.
interpretation_law.orchestration: C# and SQL may orchestrate typed batches and providers but may not parse source semantics or implement a parallel cognition engine.

status_legend.locked-profile-conformant: The exact currently declared profile artifacts passed byte and digest verification; this does not claim activated-product admission.
status_legend.present-versioned-unprofiled: A version or commit is observable and substantive content is present, but no complete Laplace source/model profile closes it.
status_legend.present-unversioned-unprofiled: Content is present without a sufficient immutable release identity or profile.
status_legend.nonconforming-to-declared-contract: The local content differs from an existing exact profile or lock contract, or omits a required artifact.
status_legend.incomplete-download: Required model weight artifacts are absent and partial download files remain.
status_legend.duplicate: The entry duplicates another observed estate and is not an independent evidence root.
status_legend.quarantined: The path is explicitly excluded from source selection.
status_legend.fixture-only: The content is test material and cannot establish source or modality completeness.
status_legend.operational-residue: The path is downloader/cache state, not a source or model artifact.

source_family_coverage.boundary: These define or relate code points, language identifiers, lexical concepts, and scoped identifiers. OMW/omw are one duplicated estate, not two independent sources.

source_family_coverage.family: predicate, frame, role, and bridge testimony
source_family_coverage.boundary: The endpoint sources and their mapping assertions require separate authority, release, dependence, and adjudication identities.
These are attributable proposition/relation corpora, not truth or foundational authority merely because they are large.

source_family_coverage.family: syntax, lexical use, translation, and document observations
source_family_coverage.boundary: Annotations, aligned sentences, dictionary entries, examples, and documents contribute exact occurrences and testimony under selected snapshot boundaries.
Grammar repositories expose concrete structure. They are dependencies of source recipes, not a knowledge seed and not semantic engines.
Selected source trees and histories may witness program structure, definitions, uses, and changes after exact repository and recipe closure.
Games are timestamped or bounded observations and outcomes, not a finite closed authority merely because local archives exist.
Fixtures can prove codecs and recipes against declared expectations but cannot establish modality or world completeness.
Explicitly excluded until a bounded, safe, exact artifact graph is selected.

Complete full-precision safetensors packages are the primary local artifact candidates. Model behavior remains experimental testimony; derived exports remain subordinate children of an exact source package and conversion receipt.

source_family_coverage.family: code observation corpora stored under the model root
source_family_coverage.boundary: Path placement does not make datasets into models. These require dataset, repository, license, privacy, duplicate, and selection manifests.

critical_findings: Only the selected Unicode 17 source contract and ISO 639-3 2026-04-15 profile are byte-conformant local profile inputs; neither is an activated-product foundational seed.
The vault CILI checkout cannot satisfy the declared CILI profile because CRLF conversion changed both selected members and the pinned archive is absent.
The two OMW directories duplicate one another and both carry mass EOL mutation, one tracked deletion, and an untracked checkpoint.
The Tree-sitter estate contains all 299 declared repositories but four are at the wrong revisions and four additional repositories lack lock disposition.

Complete full-precision safetensors snapshots are the primary local model-artifact candidates. AWQ, GGUF, TorchScript, duplicate PyTorch weights, and other converted forms are subordinate derived artifacts requiring source binding and measured loss/preservation receipts; the incomplete AWQ directory is excluded from selection.
The models root mixes model artifacts, downloader state, and three code corpora; path location cannot define semantic class.
No model artifact has a Laplace behavior experiment, effective-support law, named export invariant, or admission receipt.

The selected data universe spans every observed source family, not CILI/OMW alone, and still lacks complete profiles for XML, RDF/Turtle, CoNLL-U, JSONL, archive-paired corpora, media, PGN, code repositories, Parquet corpora, and full-precision model containers.
